title: Pitfalls of Topology-Aware Image Segmentation
mechanism: Shows that the connectivity choice, topological artefacts in the ground truth and metric misuse change the rankings of topology methods, and gives recommendations.
adaptation: Benchmark rules: fix 8-connectivity for crack components, audit tiny label fragments, report Betti / component metrics only next to overlap and relF1@2.
min_experiment: No training. Recompute component metrics for existing PF predictions under 4- and 8-connectivity, with and without fragments < 20 px. Check whether method rankings flip.
evidence: R (abstract): the three pitfalls measurably change evaluation and ranking.
